newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain slow ahead of USDA reports.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain slow ahead of USDA reports.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained slow this afternoon ahead of tomorrow's USDA supply/demand figures, market sources said.

"Only a few trades were reported as both buyers and sellers were wary of entering the market today. The high dollar and calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening on the back of supportive U.S. weekly export figures failed to attract business as sellers withdrew," one broker sadi.
May/Sept Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $289 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $140 a tonne cif for March shipment.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
